svg.title: Belief and reported deployment differ
svg.desc: Give the two attributed accounts equal visual standing. Include transcript inspection only on the belief side; separate the accounts with an amber gutter and no reconciling connector.

**Location:** `documentary-evidence-field`

**Frame:** Split evidence panel. Left: `WHAT THE BOARD BELIEVED`, with the transcript-inspection diagram. Right: `WHAT OPENAI SAYS RAN`, with answer acceptance and no transcript-inspection arrow. A dusty amber gutter divides them.

**Action:** The narrative reveals that belief and deployment are not the same account.

**Caption:**
> METR SAYS THE BOARD EXPECTED TRANSCRIPT REVIEW. OPENAI SAYS ITS DEPLOYED SCORER DID NOT PERFORM THAT CHECK.

**Provenance:** `disputed` — attributed synthesis of `METR` and `OAI-OV`; the exact prompt, scorer configuration, and harness are not public.

", "title": "Belief and reported deployment differ" } }
